caroline.description: Mail, WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal and Slack in one place: show a conversation or the list on the screen (reading and sending is done with her messages_* and send tools)

tools.name: current_view
tools.description: What the window shows: the open conversation, or the list and its filter

tools.name: show_chat
tools.description: Opens a conversation in the window: its id or a part of its title

tools.name: show_attachment
tools.description: Opens a picture or clip of a conversation in the viewer, or plays a voice message: the conversation, the message id (the number after # in messages_history) and the attachment number

tools.name: show_list
tools.description: Shows the list of conversations: service all, mail, whatsapp, telegram, signal or slack; role owner or self
